text:
Priya S.: kicking off Pelmor pilot onboarding here. High-level: 6-week POC for checkout-assistant and in-store lookup. Need to align owners, constraints, and measurable success.

Ethan L.: I'll lead integration and run the staging endpoints. Need cross-account read and a sample of anonymized receipts.

Clara (Pelmor): hi! we can share S3 with logs, but cards data is redacted. Marco (security) asked for a security checklist before sharing exports.

Priya S.: noted. Noah, can the ML team work with masked logs or do you need richer fields?

Noah G.: masked logs OK for initial intent/slot tuning. For receipts parsing we need synthetic card numbers and edge-case receipts. I can synth those.

Ethan L.: infra ask: temporary cert + staging DNS. Also will deploy a small dedicated pool. ETA for endpoint: Fri.

Priya S.: stake list: Pelmor: Clara (product), Marco (sec), Lena (ops). Redwood: Priya (CS), Ethan (Infra), Noah (ML), Arun (Customer Eng) - Arun will be backup for enablement.

Clara (Pelmor): thanks. timeline looks tight but doable. can we add a weekly 30m sync?

Priya S.: yes, weekly Wednesday 9am PT. I'll create calendar invite.

Noah G.: initial success criteria proposal:
- Functional: 95% extraction accuracy on receipts test set (extracted total/date/vendor)
- Latency: median < 250ms, p95 < 1s during test load
- Integration: JSON schema v1 validated in >= 95% of calls
- Adoption: Pelmor CS completes 2 enablement sessions and approves runbook

Ethan L.: load plan: we'll run 50 RPS synthetic for stress tests. Will share cost estimate for staging GPU pool.

SecurityBot: Automated flag: Pelmor requested S3 export. Triggering PCI questionnaire form. Link: https://security.redwood.ai/forms/pci-pelmor

Priya S.: security sync needed. Marco, would Tues 4pm PT work? We need to walk through data flow, retention, and redaction approach.

Clara (Pelmor): Tue 4pm PT works. Marco will join.

Noah G.: if PCI blocks real data, I will generate 1k synthetic receipts across 5 countries by Mon and label them for accuracy tests.

Ethan L.: sample cURL for smoke test once endpoint is up:
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.example/api/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -d '{"input":"parse receipt: \"Store: Oak, Total: $12.34, Date: 2024-03-01\""}'
```

Priya S.: owners + immediate actions: Ethan - staging endpoint + cert by Fri; Noah - synth receipts + baseline eval by Mon; Priya - schedule weekly sync + security call; Clara - confirm S3 policy or confirm synthetic fallback by EOD.

Clara (Pelmor): will confirm policy by EOD. also sending sample product scenarios and 10 example queries.

Ethan L.: noted. I'll post endpoint URL in this thread when ready and drop test token.

Priya S.: great progress. reconvene Wed 9am PT for first weekly check. Thanks everyone :rocket:

SecurityBot: Meeting created: "Pelmor security review" 2024-04-09 16:00 UTC.
